claim: Patchline model-checks a migration rollout as a finite state machine, exhaustively exploring every reachable state from the initial state and verifying a safety property holds on all of them, and when the property can be violated it returns a concrete counterexample trace of transitions leading to the bad state rather than merely reporting a boolean. The worker performs a reachability search over the transition relation, evaluates the 'never reach data_loss' invariant on every reachable state, and emits the shortest offending trace for a model that can reach the bad state. The gate proves the safe rollout model satisfies the invariant with no counterexample while a buggy model yields a counterexample trace ending in data_loss.
real_repo: patchline (self): model checking of migration rollout
